name: A1 evidence acceptance original synthetic dataset
validationDisclosure: Questions fixed before threshold calibration and validation calls. All authors and agents share the workspace. Validation shares policies and some intents with development; reviewed differences are requested facts, negated boundaries and combined constraints, documented per case. This is neither blinded nor intent-disjoint holdout, and does not prove generalization. Never select thresholds on validation results.

online.policy: Title/body/tags/shop/product copied verbatim from seed; preserve online policy independently from reference corpus.

reference.policy: Existing frozen MIT reference corpus; not imported into online business policy.

fixtures.purpose: Inactive scope test only; exact original title/body/tags; not a real shop or new policy.
Inactive scope test only; exact original title/body/tags; not a real shop or new policy.

deferred.C1: Six validation context cases require trusted prior order/product focus; retain planned rows, mark not_applicable until C1 and do not count as accepted/rejected evidence trials.

corrections: Add ET006 as equivalent evidence for development case a1-dev-013 before calibration; preserve old raw run with its original gold.
Replace validation direct paraphrases with reviewed alternative fact facets, negation boundaries and condition combinations; keep total 30/12/12/6 and 8 online positive cases.
Add KB-REFUND-PAYMENT as equivalent evidence for validation case a1-val-008 during pre-calibration semantic review; generic payment policy directly forbids treating list price as paid amount.
semanticReview.splitBasis: Requested fact or decision boundary and expression contrast, not merely different IDs. Shared policy topics and some intents are intentional for online business coverage; no claim of intent-disjoint holdout.
